```{r}
library(jsonlite)
library(tidyverse)

to_box <- "~/Library/CloudStorage/Box-Box/"

subset_name <- "batch_2_to_6"
model_version <- "fe_si_combos_pv2_mv2"

included_fragments <- fromJSON(paste0(
  to_box, "judits_work_keller_lab/fe_si_models/fragment_quality_suite/fragments/output/process_reviewed_fragments/fragments_included_all.json")) %>%
  distinct() %>%
  filter(batch != "grading_sample" & batch != "batch_1")

subset <- fromJSON(
  paste0(to_box, "judits_work_keller_lab/fe_si_images/output/process_subset/subsets_all.json")) %>%
  filter(image_name %in% included_fragments$image_name) %>%
  distinct()



fragment_dir <- paste0(to_box, "judits_work_keller_lab/fe_si_models/fragment_quality_suite/fragments/output/fragments/")

map_to_fragment_dir <- paste0(to_box, "judits_work_keller_lab/fe_si_models/merge_model_output/map_to_fragment/output/map_to_fragment/")

mucosa_dir <- paste0(to_box, "judits_work_keller_lab/fe_si_models/fragment_quality_suite/mucosa/output/mucosa/")

image_fragment_names <- unique(included_fragments$image_fragment_name)
image_names <- unique(included_fragments$image_name)

#Check that all images have downloaded and processed layer files
map_to_fragment_files <- list.files(map_to_fragment_dir)
matching_image_fragment_names <- image_fragment_names[
  sapply(image_fragment_names, function(name) any(startsWith(map_to_fragment_files, name)))
  ]

non_matching_image_fragment_names <- image_fragment_names[
  !sapply(image_fragment_names, function(name) any(startsWith(map_to_fragment_files, name)))
]

fragments_metadata <- fromJSON(paste0(to_box, "judits_work_keller_lab/fe_si_models/fragment_quality_suite/fragments/output/fragments/fragments_metadata.json")) %>%
  mutate(image_fragment_name = paste(image_name, fragment_name, sep = "_")) %>%
  filter(image_fragment_name %in% matching_image_fragment_names) %>%
  distinct()

image_fragment_names <- fragments_metadata$image_fragment_name

which(image_fragment_names == "01B2083_T6_he_2025-02-04_04")
```
